creature.name: Azarketi Crab Catcher

mid.name: Hydration
entries: Azarketi must regularly submerge themselves in water to rehydrate their water-acclimated skin. After the first 24 hours outside of water, they gain a –1 status penalty to Fortitude saves as their skin cracks and their gills become painful. After 48 hours, they struggle to breathe air and begin to suffocate until returned to water.

mid.name: Swim Away
mid.trigger: The azarketi crab catcher is targeted with an attack and can see the attacker
entries: The azarketi crab catcher gains a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack. After the attack, they Swim 5 feet.

mid.name: Submerged Stealth
entries: While submerged in water, an azarketi crab catcher gains a +2 circumstance bonus on their Stealth check, indicated above.

_aon.markdown:
The average azarketi citizen in Absalom makes a living fishing or catching crabs. After the first 24 hours outside of water, they gain a –1 status penalty to Fortitude saves as their skin cracks and their gills become painful. After 48 hours, they struggle to breathe air and begin to [suffocate](/Rules.aspx?ID=468) until returned to water.

mid.name: Sea Legs
entries: An azarketi sailor gains a +1 circumstance bonus to Acrobatics checks to Balance and can roll twice and take the better result on checks to Balance while aboard a ship.

mid.name: Submerged Stealth
entries: While submerged in water, an azarketi crab catcher gains a +2 circumstance bonus on their Stealth check, indicated above.

mid.name: Swinging Strike
entries: The azarketi sailor swings a distance equal to up to twice their Speed, moving in a straight line, and makes a single Strike at any point during the movement.

_aon.markdown:
Azarketis with more adventurous spirits often learn the art of sailing and join the crew of a ship. Such sailors get to enjoy their time above deck while also having near-constant access to large bodies of water. Ship captains also appreciate having azarketis on board, as they're able to easily scrape barnacles off the hull, check the rudder, and help patch any leaks. Though they have a talent for swimming more than sailing, they've earned a reputation as lucky to have on board. **[Recall Knowledge - Humanoid](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)** ([Society](/Skills.aspx?ID=14)): DC 16 **[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 14 **[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 11 [Azarketi Sailor](/NPCs.aspx?ID=1748) **Source** [Absalom, City of Lost Omens](/Sources.aspx?ID=108) pg. 396 **Perception** +8 **Languages** [Common](/Languages.aspx?ID=1) **Skills** [Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=1) +8, [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +7, [Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=10) +5, [Sailing Lore](/Skills.aspx?ID=8) +6, [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) +8 **Str** +3 **Dex** +4 **Con** +2 **Int** +0 **Wis** +1 **Cha** +1 **Items** [Composite Longbow](/Weapons.aspx?ID=74) (20 arrows), [Scimitar](/Weapons.aspx?ID=38), [studded leather](/Armor.aspx?ID=5) --- **AC** 18 **Fort** +8 **Ref** +11 **Will** +5 **HP** 30 **Hydration** Azarketi must regularly submerge themselves in water to rehydrate their water-acclimated skin. mid.name: Submerged Stealth

mid.name: Aquatic Predator
entries: While submerged in water, an azarketi tide tamer takes advantage of the shifting tides to increase the deadliness of their attacks. They deal 2d8 additional damage on a successful weapon Strike while they are underwater.

_aon.markdown:
The most ambitious and capable azarketis become tide tamers, learning how to speak with aquatic animals and even train the strongest of these creatures to help defend their territory. Tide tamers act as guardians for their communities, scouts at sea and on the shore, or even entertainers for land-bound people's amusement. They're generally found with one or more aquatic allies whom they've befriended. Several serve alongside Absalom's Wave Riders as scouts, animal interlocutors, and guides. **[Recall Knowledge - Humanoid](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)** ([Society](/Skills.aspx?ID=14)): DC 23 **[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 21 **[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 18 [Azarketi Tide Tamer](/NPCs.aspx?ID=1749) **Source** [Absalom, City of Lost Omens](/Sources.aspx?ID=108) pg. 397 **Perception** +15 **Languages** [Common](/Languages.aspx?ID=1) **Skills** [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +15, [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=7) +15, [Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=10) +12, [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) +15, [Survival](/Skills.aspx?ID=16) +14, [Underwater Lore](/Skills.aspx?ID=8) +11 **Str** +4 **Dex** +4 **Con** +2 **Int** +0 **Wis** +1 **Cha** +2 **Items** _+1 [trident](/Weapons.aspx?ID=45)_, [Hand Crossbow](/Weapons.aspx?ID=69), [Studded Leather Armor](/Armor.aspx?ID=5) --- **AC** 25 **Fort** +15 **Ref** +18 **Will** +12 **HP** 115 **Hydration** Azarketi must regularly submerge themselves in water to rehydrate their water-acclimated skin. After 48 hours, they struggle to breathe air and begin to [suffocate](/Rules.aspx?ID=468) until returned to water.
**Speaker of the Oceans** An azarketi tide tamer can speak with animals that have the [aquatic](/Traits.aspx?ID=168) or [amphibious](/Traits.aspx?ID=207) trait.
